keys: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Juegas solo contra un reloj de %lld minutos, buscando tu mejor puntuación.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Tu joues seul contre une horloge de %lld minutes, pour ton meilleur score.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Du spielst allein gegen eine Uhr von %lld Minuten, für deine beste Punktzahl.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Giochi da solo contro un orologio di %lld minuti, per il tuo miglior punteggio.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Jogas sozinho contra um relógio de %lld minutos, pela tua melhor pontuação.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Você joga sozinho contra um relógio de %lld minutos, pela sua melhor pontuação.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: %lld分の時計を相手に一人でプレイし、自己ベストを目指そう。

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: %lld분 시계를 상대로 혼자 플레이하며 최고 점수에 도전하세요.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: 你独自对抗%lld分钟的时钟，争取最好成绩。

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: Ты играешь один против часов на %lld минут — на свой лучший счёт.

translations.key: You play alone against a %lld-minute clock, for your best score.
translations.text: تلعب وحدك ضد ساعة مدتها %lld دقيقة، لتحقق أفضل نتيجة لك.
